title: AnalysisRefRequest
description: Names one stored analysis of one repository: the parameters of analysis.trace, analysis.checkFreshness and analysis.delete. Both fields are required, because each of those calls is about a specific run the reviewer is looking at, and 'the latest' is a guess the renderer never needs to make — it always holds the id. The repository travels too, so an id from another repository is refused rather than read.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root, as repository.open returned it.

analysisId.description: The stored analysis, as AnalysisView.analysisId or the library named it.
